steps.title: Build a fruit vote

options.label: Each picture is one person. How many people chose apple?
Make one counter for each of the four apple votes.
Which fruit has the most votes?

steps.hint: Read the apple label, then count the pictures in that row.
steps.explanation: Link one vote to one picture, then read the fruit choices.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Build a fruit vote
mathWorkshop.goal: Link one vote to one picture, then read the fruit choices.

tasks.prompt: Each picture is one person. How many people chose apple?
tasks.feedback: Four apple pictures stand for four people.
tasks.hint: Read the apple label, then count the pictures in that row.

tasks.prompt: Make one counter for each of the four apple votes.
tasks.feedback: Four votes need four counters: one counter for each person.
tasks.hint: One person needs one counter. Stop when every apple vote has a counter.

tasks.prompt: Which fruit has the most votes?
tasks.feedback: Apple has the most pictures, so it has the most votes.
tasks.hint: Compare equal-size pictures from the same starting line.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Counting votes
steps.hint: Find the apple row and count its pictures once.
steps.explanation: One picture represents one person. The apple row has 4.
steps.shortExplanation: One picture represents one person. The apple row has 4.

steps.title: The favourite
steps.hint: Which row has the most pictures?
steps.explanation: The apple row has the most pictures.
steps.shortExplanation: The apple row has the most pictures.

steps.title: The fewest
steps.prompt: Which fruit did the fewest people choose?
steps.hint: Which row has the fewest pictures?
steps.explanation: Mango has the fewest pictures: one.
steps.shortExplanation: Mango has the fewest pictures: one.

steps.title: Two rows together
steps.prompt: How many chose banana and orange together?
steps.hint: Count the banana pictures, then count on the orange ones.
steps.explanation: Two chose banana and 3 chose orange. Together that is 5.
steps.shortExplanation: Two chose banana and 3 chose orange. Together that is 5.

steps.title: Everyone asked
steps.prompt: How many people were asked altogether?
steps.hint: Count every picture in every row once.

steps.title: Sorting by colour
steps.hint: Ask one question about each toy: is it red?
steps.explanation: Red objects go in red. Every other colour goes in not red.
steps.shortExplanation: Red objects go in red. Every other colour goes in not red.

source.answerKeyText: red: red car, red ball • not red: blue ball, green car

steps.title: Pet votes
steps.prompt: Sara, Laila and Nour chose cat. Omar chose dog. Adam chose fish. Match each pet to its total.
steps.hint: Count how many children chose each pet.
steps.explanation: Count each vote once: 3 cats, 1 dog and 1 fish.
steps.shortExplanation: Count each vote once: 3 cats, 1 dog and 1 fish.

steps.title: Colour votes
steps.prompt: Four friends voted for their favourite colour. Each circle is one vote. How many votes are there altogether?
steps.hint: Each circle is one vote. Count all the circles.
steps.explanation: There is one equal circle for each vote: 2 + 1 + 1 = 4 votes.
steps.shortExplanation: There is one equal circle for each vote: 2 + 1 + 1 = 4 votes.

source.answerKeyText: Four circles in total, same size, lined up in rows by colour.

steps.title: The picture key
steps.prompt: In our pictogram, each picture stands for...
steps.hint: Read the key under the pictogram.
steps.explanation: The key says each picture shows one person.
steps.shortExplanation: The key says each picture shows one person.

steps.title: The longest row
steps.prompt: The longest row in a pictogram shows the...
steps.hint: More pictures make a row longer.
steps.explanation: The longest row has the most pictures, so it shows the most.
steps.shortExplanation: The longest row has the most pictures, so it shows the most.

steps.title: Block graphs
steps.prompt: Look at the graph. What is it made of?
steps.hint: Look at what each column is built from.
steps.explanation: A block graph is built from equal square blocks.
steps.shortExplanation: A block graph is built from equal square blocks.

steps.title: Orange votes
steps.prompt: In the picture above, how many people chose orange?
steps.hint: Find the orange row and count its pictures.
steps.explanation: The orange row has three pictures, so 3 people chose orange.
steps.shortExplanation: The orange row has three pictures, so 3 people chose orange.

steps.title: Fair pictograms
steps.prompt: Pictures in a pictogram should be...

options.label: the same size and lined up

steps.hint: How can we compare the rows fairly?
steps.explanation: Same-size pictures in lines let us compare rows fairly.
steps.shortExplanation: Same-size pictures in lines let us compare rows fairly.

source.answerKeyText: the same size and lined up

stickers.meaning: A chart where each picture stands for one thing.

homeActivities.text: Ask family members their favourite fruit. Put one equal-size drawing per vote in rows. Read the totals and sort toys by red/not red.
homeActivities.textAr: اسألوا أهل البيت عن الفاكهة المفضلة عندهم. ارسموا لكل صوت رسمة واحدة بنفس الحجم، وحطّوها في صفوف. اقروا المجموع، وبعدين قسّموا اللعب لأحمر ومش أحمر.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Ask each family member for a favourite fruit and put one spoon in that fruit's row. Count the apple row.
goalActivities.textAr: اسألوا أهل البيت عن فاكهتهم المفضلة، وكل واحد يحط معلقة في صف الفاكهة دي. عدّوا صف التفاح.

goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Look at your spoon chart. Your child finds the longest row: that fruit is the favourite.

goalActivities.text: In the same chart, find the shortest row: the fruit the fewest people chose.
goalActivities.textAr: في نفس الرسم، دوّروا على أقصر صف: الفاكهة اللي أقل ناس اختاروها.

goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Count the banana row and the orange row, then count both rows together.
goalActivities.textAr: عدّوا صف الموز وصف البرتقان، وبعدين عدّوا الصفّين مع بعض.

goalActivities.text: Count every spoon in the chart: one spoon for each person asked.
goalActivities.textAr: عدّوا كل المعالق في الرسم: كل معلقة لشخص اتسأل.

goalActivities.text: Sort a few toys into two groups: red and not red. Your child explains where each toy goes and why.

goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا صفّين كوبايات لمشروبين بيحبهم أهل البيت. الصف الأطول بيوضّح المشروب اللي أكتر ناس اختاروه.

goalActivities.text: Build a block graph with blocks or Lego: one block for each person's vote. Talk about how each column is built from equal blocks.
goalActivities.textAr: ابنوا رسم بياني بالمكعبات أو الليجو: مكعب لكل صوت. اتكلموا إن كل عمود معمول من مكعبات قد بعض.

goalActivities.text: In your picture chart, your child counts the pictures in one row and says how many people chose that fruit.
